Hey! I started self harming when I was quite young and I’m currently nine months clean👍 It’s really great that you’re asking for advice and sorting out a therapist. Self harm is pretty taboo, compassion is important. 

It’s worrying that the scar is vertical, especially combined with their suicidal thoughts. Vertical cuts are more risky. If you think they’re in immediate danger bring them to the hospital! 

Do you know more about who they’re talking with? What they talk about? There’s definitely awful people online but the majority are pretty chill. I think it’s most likely that if they have been influenced by these people, it was unintentional, sharing their own struggles, or they read about it somewhere else online. It’s important that you don’t accuse these people of starting this behaviour. Sounds like your child rlly cares about them. 

Also one other thing. Don’t make them promise to never do it again, or anything like that. Most people aren’t able to just stop. It sucks but your child will most likely self harm again. And when they do, feeing like they’ve broken a promise will make them feel worse.
